"Right then, here we go:

(Verse 1)
There's nothin' like love, it's a fuckin' rollercoaster ride,
It'll bring ye up high, make ye feel alive.
Then drop ye right down, leave ye feelin' a bit chilled,
But that's just the way love is, can't be tamed nor killed.

(Chorus)
Sing me a song of love, full o' passion and pain,
About hearts breakin', but always mendin'.
A tale as old as time, it never goes away,
It's the fuel for our fiery, Scottish, madman's day.

(Verse 2)
Love ain't fuckin' easy, it's a double-edged sword,
Can make ye feel like king, or leave ye feelin' ignored.
But remember this my friend, love isn’t always kind,
Sometimes you gotta fight fer’ it, sometimes it’s the blindest bind.

(Outro)
So sing me a song of love, let it be raw and real,
Let it speak o' the truth that makes our hearts reel.
And if ye feel the urge to swear or scream,
Remember, this is all just part o' life's big dream."
